caseNameFull: Clifford ZUCKER, as Plan Administrator for BankUnited Financial Corp. v. FEDERAL DEPOSIT INSURANCE CORPORATION, in its Capacity as Receiver of BankUnited, FSB

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner to defer consideration of the petition for writ of certiorari denied. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Eleventh Circuit denied.
